title: GR-OPD: Group-Relative Sequence Credit for On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.23042v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides token-level teacher feedback, yet common sampled-token updates assign credit locally and omit the effects of earlier actions on subsequent feedback. We introduce \method{} (Group-Relative On-Policy Distillation), which decouples feedback computation from credit assignment by aggregating token feedback into calibrated sequence-level credit. We establish a theoretical basis for this approach by showing that, under ideal on-policy assumptions, broadcasting raw summed feedback to every response token yields an unbiased estimate of the negative gradient of the sequence-level reverse-KL objective. To support effective learning in practice, \method{} discounts later feedback that may become less reliable under distribution shift and uses same-prompt rollout groups to calibrate teacher guidance. It preserves relative response preferences while retaining a controlled fraction of the group mean, which we term

translated_title: GR-OPD：基于组相对序列信度的在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation, OPD）能够提供词元级别的教师反馈，然而常见的采样词元更新方式只在局部进行信度分配，忽略了早期动作对后续反馈的影响。我们提出了GR-OPD（组相对在线策略蒸馏），该方法通过将词元反馈聚合为经过校准的序列级信度，将反馈计算与信度分配解耦。我们为这一方法建立了理论基础：在理想的在线策略假设下，将原始的反馈总和广播到每个响应词元上，可得到序列级反向KL目标负梯度的无偏估计。为了在实践中有助于有效学习，GR-OPD对在分布偏移下可能变得不可靠的后续反馈进行折扣处理，并利用相同提示词的采样组来校准教师指导。该方法在保留相对响应偏好的同时，保留了受控比例的组均值，我们称之为……
tldr: GR-OPD提出了一种组相对的序列级信度分配方法，通过聚合词元级教师反馈、折扣不可靠的后续反馈并利用同提示采样组校准指导，解决了在线策略蒸馏中局部信度分配的缺陷，并从理论上证明了其对反向KL目标梯度的无偏估计性质。
en_tdlr: GR-OPD resolves the local credit assignment deficiency in on-policy distillation by aggregating token-level teacher feedback into group-relative sequence-level credit with discounting and same-prompt group calibration, theoretically shown to yield an unbiased estimate of the reverse-KL objective gradient.
